Name: Omri, King of Israel
Summary: Omri, commander of Israel's army, was made king after Zimri's death, prevailed over the rival Tibni, built Samaria on Shemer's hill, and did worse than all before him, establishing the dynasty of Ahab.
KeyStory: Omri prevails over Tibni and builds Samaria.
RelatedPeople: Zimri, King of Israel; Tibni, King of Israel; Shemer, Owner of Samaria's Hill; King Ahab; Athaliah; Ahaziah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Political skill without godliness only builds a stronger platform for sin.
